auth.pitch: Trace, recover and declare your textile waste.
auth.point1: Every lot followed by QR code, from the workstation to its final destination
auth.point2: Register, tracking slips and ANGed declaration generated automatically
auth.point3: Recovery rate and financial balance in real time
auth.passwordRule: At least 12 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.

login.title: Sign in
login.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
login.codeHint: Enter the code shown by your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
login.chooseCompany: Choose the company you want to work with.

register.title: Create an account
register.industrialHint: You produce textile waste and want to trace, recover and declare it.
register.providerHint: You collect, transport or treat waste. Access is free; your accreditations are checked by the platform.
register.planHint: Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial, with no payment.
register.doneBody: A confirmation link valid for 24 hours has been sent to {{email}}. Your registration will then be reviewed by Diva Software; you will be told by email.
register.problems: To correct before creating the account:

missing.fields: Required fields of the company or the contact are empty or incorrect (they are marked in red).
missing.roles: Choose at least one provider role.
missing.accreditations: Complete each accreditation: type, number, start date and expiry date.
missing.files: Attach the PDF file of each accreditation.
missing.activities: Choose at least one textile activity.
missing.accept: You must accept the documents to create the account.

verify.doneBody: Your registration has been passed to Diva Software for review. You will receive an email as soon as it is processed.
verify.failedBody: This confirmation link is no longer valid (it lasts 24 hours). Sign in to receive a new one.

forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.lead: Enter the email address of your account: we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has just been sent. It is valid for 60 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password changed. You can sign in.

invitation.title: Join {{company}}
invitation.lead: You are invited with the role "{{role}}" ({{email}}).
invitation.existing: You already have a DivaWaste account with this address: accept the invitation, then sign in with your usual password.
invitation.done: Invitation accepted. You can sign in.
invitation.invalidBody: This invitation has expired, was cancelled or has already been used. Ask your administrator to send you a new one.

status.title: Status of your account
status.pending_verification: Confirm your email address: it is the first step before your registration is reviewed.
status.pending_approval: Your registration is being reviewed by Diva Software. You will be told by email.
status.suspended: Access for this company is suspended.
status.none: Your account is not attached to any company.
status.emailUnverified: The address {{email}} is not confirmed yet.

errors.UNEXPECTED: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
errors.NETWORK: The server cannot be reached. Check your network and try again.
errors.GENERIC: The operation failed (error {{status}}). Reference to give to support: {{reference}}.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Incorrect email or password. After 5 failed attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.INVALID_CODE: Incorrect code, or code already used.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the rights needed for this action.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item does not exist or is no longer accessible.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.PAYMENT_REQUIRED: Your subscription has ended: the account is read-only. Choose a plan under "Subscription".
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This lot cannot move to that status from its current status.
errors.LOT_NOT_AVAILABLE: One of the lots is no longer available for a pickup.
errors.LOT_IN_PICKUP: One of the lots is already in a pickup in progress.
errors.LOT_NOT_TRANSFORMABLE: This lot can no longer be split or grouped.
errors.LOT_NOT_WEIGHABLE: This lot can no longer be reweighed: it is already committed to a pickup.
errors.LOT_VERSION_CONFLICT: This lot was changed in the meantime. Reload it before trying again.
errors.SPLIT_WEIGHT_GAP: The weight difference exceeds 2 %: add a comment to explain it.
errors.GROUP_MIXED_LOTS: Lots to group must be from the same site, of the same type and of the same hazard status.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This provider cannot be chosen: it is not an active partner or has no valid accreditation on the planned date.
errors.INVALID_PICKUP_TRANSITION: This action is not possible in the current state of the pickup.
errors.VARIANCE_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: The weight variance must be acknowledged before closing the pickup.
errors.TREATMENT_MISSING: The provider has not yet declared the treatment of every lot received.
errors.PICKUP_NOT_PRICEABLE: Prices are entered once the lots have been collected.
errors.SITE_HAS_STOCK: This site still holds lots: evacuate them before closing it.
errors.WASTE_TYPE_HAS_STOCK: Lots of this type are still in stock.
errors.THRESHOLD_EXISTS: A limit of the same kind already exists for this site, zone and type. The same stock may have one limit by weight, one in pieces, one in volume and one per packaging — not two of the same kind.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the company.
errors.INVITATION_PENDING: An invitation is already pending for this address.
errors.LAST_ADMINISTRATOR: The company must keep at least one active administrator.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role is still assigned to users or invitations.
errors.NO_HAZARDOUS_LOTS: This pickup contains no hazardous waste: no tracking slip is required.
errors.MANIFEST_CODE_MISSING: A hazardous lot has no waste code: complete the waste type first.
errors.MANIFEST_PICKUP_NOT_READY: The tracking slip is drawn up once the provider has confirmed the pickup.
errors.NOT_YOUR_TURN: This tracking slip is waiting for another party's signature.
errors.MANIFEST_NOT_SIGNABLE: This tracking slip is no longer waiting for a signature.
errors.DECLARATION_LOCKED: This declaration is validated: it can no longer be changed.
errors.DECLARATION_FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE: No declaration format is configured for this country yet.
errors.REPORT_TOO_LARGE: Too many rows for this format: shorten the period or use the Excel export.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_PAYABLE: This invoice can no longer receive a payment.
errors.CERTIFICATE_PICKUP_NOT_READY: The certificate is uploaded once the lots have been collected.
errors.INVALID_COMPANY_TRANSITION: A decision has already been made for this company.
errors.ACCREDITATION_ALREADY_REVIEWED: This accreditation already has that status.
errors.DEVICE_REVOKED: This device was revoked by an administrator.
errors.COLOR_IN_USE: This colour is used by lots, waste types, materials or zones. Withdraw it from the list instead.
errors.RECEIVED_LOT_IN_USE: The number of a received lot cannot change once an order or a waste lot names it.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_EXCEEDED: The authorisation does not cover this pickup: one of its limits would be exceeded. Each limit is detailed on the Authorisations page.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE: The authorisation cannot be verified: some lots have no measured weight. Weigh them, then try again.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_PACKAGING: The authorisation is stated in packages only and some lots are loose or in a packaging it does not name: it cannot be verified for them.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_MISSING: No authorisation covers this waste on this date. Record one before requesting the pickup.
errors.providerRequirement: {{provider}} does not take this collection as it stands — {{problems}}
errors.providerRequirementOverridable: {{provider}} does not take this collection as it stands — {{problems}} You may send it all the same by giving the reason.
errors.PROVIDER_REQUIREMENT_NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION: Only an authorised person may send a request despite a blocking requirement of the provider.
errors.PARTNER_NOT_LINKED: This partner has no account: its requirements are simply edited.
errors.REGULATORY_CODE_MISSING: A hazardous waste type of this pickup has no regulatory code: complete it on the waste type, its tracking slip cannot be issued without it.
errors.NO_REQUIREMENT_EXCEPTION: No blocking requirement is waiting for an explanation on this pickup.

stock.threshold_warning.title: Stock limit almost reached — {{site}}
stock.threshold_warning.body: Stock is at {{quantity}} for a limit of {{max_quantity}} ({{scope}}).

stock.threshold_exceeded.title: Stock limit exceeded — {{site}}
stock.threshold_exceeded.body: Stock is at {{quantity}}, above the limit of {{max_quantity}} by {{excess}} ({{scope}}). Plan a pickup.

pickup.variance_flagged.title: Discrepancy at reception — pickup {{number}}
pickup.variance_flagged.body: {{received}} received for {{departure}} at departure: at least one lot is outside tolerance.

accreditation.expired.title: Accreditation expired — {{provider}}
accreditation.expired.body: {{reference}} expired on {{date}}: this provider can no longer be chosen.

subscription.trial_ending.title: Free trial ends on {{date}}
subscription.trial_ending.body: {{days}} day(s) left. Choose a plan to continue.

document.signed_copy_requested.title: Tracking slip {{number}}: signed copy to attach
document.signed_copy_requested.body: Every party has signed. Attach the scan of the copy signed by hand.

authorization.expiring_soon.title: Authorisation {{reference}}: ends on {{date}}
authorization.expiring_soon.body: {{waste_type}}: in {{days}} day(s). Without a new authorisation, pickups will be blocked.

stock.threshold_unverifiable.title: Stock limit cannot be verified — {{site}}
stock.threshold_unverifiable.body: Limit of {{max_quantity}} ({{scope}}): the known quantity is {{quantity}}, but {{unweighed_lots}} lot(s) cannot be counted in this unit ({{lots}}): weight, quantity or number of packages not on record. The limit is not exceeded on what is known, and it cannot be called respected: complete these lots.

capacity.space_warning.title: Zone almost full — {{scope}}
capacity.space_warning.body: The room of the zone is {{pct}} % used ({{detail}}). No lot is refused; think about making room.

capacity.space_exceeded.title: Zone room exceeded — {{scope}}
capacity.space_exceeded.body: The room of the zone is {{pct}} % used ({{detail}}): its capacity is exceeded. Lots are still accepted; make room or review the capacity of the zone.

capacity.space_unverifiable.title: Zone room cannot be verified — {{scope}}
capacity.space_unverifiable.body: The known room is at least {{pct}} % used ({{detail}}), but {{missing}} lot(s) cannot be counted ({{lots}}): volume or packaging not on record. This is not a confirmed exceedance; the occupancy cannot be called within capacity.

capacity.load_warning.title: Zone load almost reached — {{scope}}
capacity.load_warning.body: The zone bears {{detail}} ({{pct}} % of its maximum load).

capacity.load_exceeded.title: Zone load exceeded — {{scope}}
capacity.load_exceeded.body: The zone bears {{detail}}: its maximum load is exceeded by {{excess}}. Lots are still accepted; move or evacuate lots.

capacity.load_unverifiable.title: Zone load cannot be verified — {{scope}}
capacity.load_unverifiable.body: Known weight: {{detail}}, but {{missing}} lot(s) are not weighed ({{lots}}). This is not a confirmed exceedance; the load cannot be called respected: weigh these lots.

capacity.site_warning.title: Site capacity almost reached — {{site}}
capacity.site_warning.body: The site holds {{detail}} ({{pct}} % of its maximum weight), all zones together.

capacity.site_exceeded.title: Site capacity exceeded — {{site}}
capacity.site_exceeded.body: The site holds {{detail}}, all zones together: its maximum weight is exceeded by {{excess}}. Lots are still accepted; plan a pickup.

capacity.site_unverifiable.title: Site capacity cannot be verified — {{site}}
capacity.site_unverifiable.body: Known weight on the site: {{detail}}, but {{missing}} lot(s) are not weighed ({{lots}}). This is not a confirmed exceedance; the capacity cannot be called respected: weigh these lots.

pickup.requirements_unmet_at_loading.title: Pickup {{number}} loaded — a requirement is not met
pickup.requirements_unmet_at_loading.body: {{quantity}} at departure, {{left}} lot(s) left on site. On what left: {{requirements}}.

pickup.requirement_exception.title: Pickup {{number}} left under a requirement of {{provider}}
pickup.requirement_exception.body: On what was loaded ({{quantity}}): {{requirements}}. The departure is not undone; say why.

notifications.mailOnRequest: Email only if you ask for it: by default, stock and capacity alerts are emailed to the people who manage the limits or the zones of the site. You always see them here.

dashboard.production: Origin of the waste in production
dashboard.productionHint: The manufacturing orders that produced the most waste over the period.

lots.title: Waste lots
lots.subtitle: Each lot is identified by a QR code and followed to its final destination.
lots.emptyHint: Lots are created at the workshop, from the mobile app or this button.
lots.splitHint: The original lot is closed and replaced by the new lots, each with its own label.
lots.groupHint: The selected lots are closed and replaced by a single lot with a new label.
lots.qrHint: The QR code on the label identifies this lot. Without a reader, type its number: {{number}}.

zoneMismatch.type: This zone is not meant for this waste type. You can still continue.
zoneMismatch.color: This zone is not meant for this colour. You can still continue.

lots.productionOrderHint: Optional. The stage is deduced from the zone, the material from the order.
lots.originHint: Where this lot comes from in production. Leave empty what you do not know: the stage is deduced from the zone, the material from the order.
lots.countedHint: This waste is declared by quantity, not by weight.
lots.weightComputed: Left empty, the weight is computed from the quantity.
lots.weightUnknown: Left empty, the weight stays unknown: it is not estimated.
lots.weighLaterHint: Leave empty if the lot is not weighed yet: its weight will stay "to be weighed", never zero.
lots.weightEstimated: This weight is an estimate, not a weighing
lots.packageCountHint: One lot may hold several bags, bales or boxes. Left empty: 1 package, marked "default".
lots.packagesOnSite: Give the real number of packages of the lot. A pickup being prepared takes this number.
lots.packagesAfterDeparture: The lot has left the site: this is a correction. The number the pickup and the authorisation were decided with is kept; the corrected number is shown beside it and recorded in the history.
lots.packagesDefaultHint: The current number is a default: nobody has confirmed it yet.
lots.splitPackagesHint: The original lot counts {{count}} package(s): give the packages of each new lot, as you count them.
lots.groupPackages: Number of packages of the grouped lot
lots.groupPackagesHint: Count the result: three lots put in one bale are one package. Left empty: 1, as a default.

stock.title: Waste stock
stock.subtitle: Calculated in real time from the lots present on site.
stock.emptyHint: Stock appears as soon as a lot is created on a site.
stock.noThreshold: No limit defined. A limit warns you before a zone or a site holds too much waste.
stock.misplacedHint: The waste type or the colour of these lots is not planned in this zone.
stock.limitsHint: A limit is a maximum weight for a site, a zone or a waste type. You get an alert when the limit is close, then another if it is exceeded.
stock.limitIntro: Choose what the limit watches (a site, a zone, a waste type) and in which unit: weight, pieces, volume or number of packages. The same stock may have several limits, for example a weight and a number of bags; each is evaluated separately.
stock.maxHint: Quantity not to exceed, in the unit chosen.
stock.warningHint: You are warned when the stock reaches this percentage of the limit.

scope.siteType: this type on the whole site

stock.unconfirmed: {{count}} lot(s) with a default number of packages
stock.unconfirmedHint: These lots count as one package for want of a figure. Correct their number of packages if they hold several.
stock.maxHintPackages: Number of packages not to exceed: a whole number. A lot of 12 bags counts as 12.
stock.unitHint: Pieces and volumes are offered only when this waste type is counted that way, or states the weight of a piece or its density.
stock.unitHintAnyType: For all waste types, the limit is counted by weight or in packages. Choose a waste type for a limit in pieces or in volume.
stock.packagingCountedHint: Only the packages of this packaging are counted. Loose lots and lots in another packaging are not concerned; they are pointed out.
stock.unitFixed: The unit of a limit cannot be changed. To watch the same stock in another unit, add another limit: each has its own answer.
stock.limitPreview: {{where}}: alert when the stock of "{{what}}" exceeds {{max}} {{unit}}, and from {{pct}} % of that limit. No lot is refused.
stock.limitPreviewAll: {{where}}: alert when the stock, all waste together, exceeds {{max}} {{unit}}, and from {{pct}} % of that limit. No lot is refused.
stock.limitOutside: {{count}} other lot(s) of the scope, loose or in another packaging than {{packaging}}: not concerned by this limit.

sites.title: Sites and zones
sites.subtitle: Your production sites and their workshop and storage zones.
sites.emptyHint: Create your first site to start recording lots.
sites.closeHint: The site stays in the history and in documents; it is no longer offered for new lots.
sites.capacityHint: Say how many packages the zone holds when it receives a single packaging: "40 bales", "100 bags". Mixed packagings share the same room: 20 bales of 40 and 50 bags of 100 fill the zone. A lot that is loose or in a packaging that is not planned is reported, never converted.
sites.capacityKgLimit: Maximum load of the zone (kg), optional
sites.reservedHint: Optional. A lot that does not match is reported, never refused.
sites.siteCapacityHint: The total weight the site may hold, all zones together. Every lot on the site counts once, even in a zone without a limit. Leave empty if nothing is to be watched. Going over this capacity alerts; it never refuses a lot.
sites.siteCapacityKg: Maximum weight on the site (kg), optional
sites.siteLoadHint: Every lot on the site, counted once whatever its zone, against the maximum weight of the site.
sites.noSiteCapacityLong: Site capacity not defined: {{kg}} on the site ({{count}} lot(s)), nothing is watched.

spaceMethods.packaging: Packages per packaging ("100 bags or 50 boxes")

sites.capacityM3Required: Enter the volume of the zone, above 0.
sites.volumeHint: The room taken is the sum of the volumes of the lots: packages × volume of one package (set in Sites › Packaging volumes), or the measured volume of a loose lot, or its weight ÷ the density of its waste type. A lot whose volume is not known is reported, never estimated. A zone is measured one way: in volume, the quantities per packaging are not used.
sites.packagingVolumesHint: The room one package takes once stored, in m³. Used by zones whose room is measured in volume. Leave empty if you do not know it: the lots concerned will be reported "without a known volume", never estimated.
sites.packagingVolumesInvalid: A volume must be a number above 0 (4 decimals at most), or empty.
sites.inactiveVolume: Volume on record, not used: {{m3}} m³.
sites.inactiveVolumeHint: Some zones of this site have a volume (m³) on record while their room is measured in packages. Open the site to review them.
sites.inactiveVolumeBanner: {{count}} zone(s) have a volume (m³) on record that is not used: their room is measured in packages. Nothing was erased. Open each zone ("Review") and choose "Volume (m³)" if that volume really is the capacity of the zone; otherwise leave it in packages.
sites.inactiveVolumeInForm: A volume of {{m3}} m³ is on record for this zone and is not used: its room is measured in packages. Choose "Volume (m³)" above to use it. It stays on record as long as you do not change it.

wasteTypes.title: Waste types
wasteTypes.subtitle: Activate types from the reference catalogue or create your own.
wasteTypes.frozen: The code, family, waste code and hazard status are frozen after creation: lots and regulatory documents refer to them.
wasteTypes.emptyHint: Activate at least one type from the catalogue to be able to create lots.
wasteTypes.requiresAuthorization: This waste only leaves the site under an authorisation (declaration signed by customs)

unitHint.mass: Lots are declared by weight; gaps are judged in kilos.
unitHint.count: Lots are declared by number of pieces; gaps are judged in pieces, never converted to kilos.
unitHint.volume: Lots are declared by volume; gaps are judged in volume.

wasteTypes.codeCompleted: Regulatory code saved: the waiting lots carry it.
wasteTypes.codeRequired: A hazardous waste needs its regulatory code: without it no tracking slip can be issued.

codeDialog.title: Regulatory code — {{name}}
codeDialog.completeHint: This hazardous type was created without a code. The code chosen is saved once and does not change; lots of this type without one receive it, and their slips can be issued. Existing slips are not changed.
codeDialog.activateHint: This catalogue waste is hazardous and has no code of your country: choose it to activate the type.

pickups.title: Pickups
pickups.subtitle: Requests sent to providers, from loading to closing.
pickups.emptyHint: Create a pickup request from the lots in stock.

create.title: New pickup request
create.noLots: No lot available on this site.
create.hazardousWarning: The selection contains hazardous waste: only a receiver authorised for hazardous waste can be chosen.
create.noReceiver: No receiver available. Add a partner in
create.transporterRequired: This receiver does not transport: choose a transporter.

authorization.missing: no authorisation covers this waste on that date. Record one before requesting the pickup.
authorization.exceeded: authorisation {{reference}} has not enough quantity left. Record a new authorisation.
authorization.packaging: authorisation {{reference}} is stated in packages only; these lots are loose or in a packaging it does not name: {{lots}}. It cannot be checked for them.
authorization.covered: covered by authorisation {{reference}}. Each limit after this pickup:
authorization.unverifiable: authorisation {{reference}} is limited in weight and these lots have no measured weight: {{lots}}. Weigh them before requesting the pickup.

pickups.collectHint: Tick the lots actually loaded and check what leaves, in the unit of the lot. A weight left empty stays unknown. A lot left unticked goes back to stock.
pickups.receiveHint: Enter what was received for each lot, in its unit (weight, pieces or litres). A gap above the tolerance of the waste is reported to the industrial.
pickups.treatHint: Give the treatment channel of each lot received.
pickups.priceHint: Sale price (revenue) or disposal cost, per lot. The amount is calculated on the weight received.
pickups.varianceBanner: Weight received {{received}} for {{departure}} at departure, a variance of {{pct}} %.
pickups.certificateFile: File (PDF, JPEG or PNG, 20 MB maximum)
pickups.completeHint: The lots move to the status "Closed": weights, channels and prices can no longer be changed.
pickups.onBehalf: {{name}} has no account: record its answer, the reception and the treatment of the lots yourself.
pickups.plannedChannelHint: It selects the tolerance applied at reception.
pickups.plannedChannelDefault: The one planned for each waste type
pickups.priceNeedsWeight: Cannot be calculated: lot not weighed. Choose a flat amount.

compliance.title: Documents of the pickup

hint.incomplete: Lots that left have no tracking slip. {{done}} of {{total}} slip(s) complete.
hint.pending: Closing the pickup does not complete its documents: {{done}} of {{total}} slip(s) signed by every party.
hint.complete: Every slip is signed by every party and archived ({{total}}).

compliance.missingCode: {{type}} ({{code}}) is hazardous and has no regulatory code: {{count}} lot(s) without a slip ({{lots}}). No code is guessed.
compliance.completeCode: Complete the code of the type
compliance.withoutSlip: {{count}} lot(s) left without a slip: {{lots}}. Issue the slips.

waitingFor.signed_copy: waits for the scan of the slip signed by hand

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Your partners without an account and the directory of approved collectors, transporters and recyclers.
providers.notSelectable: Cannot be chosen for a pickup
providers.emptyHint: No published provider matches these criteria.
providers.blocking: Refuse the request when this is not met
providers.blockingOn: A collection below it, or whose quantity cannot be verified, cannot be requested from you — unless an authorised person at the client decides otherwise with a reason, which you may refuse.
providers.blockingOff: The client is warned and may send the request; you will see it with this warning.
providers.addsToFamilyOn: Lots of this type also count in the requirement of their family.
providers.addsToFamilyOff: For lots of this type, this line replaces the family line.

register.title: Chronological waste register
register.subtitle: Generated automatically from the lots: nothing to type.
register.exportQueued: Export requested: you will be notified as soon as it is ready (Reports page).

manifests.title: Waste tracking slips
manifests.subtitle: One slip per waste collected, hazardous or not. Pre-filled from the pickup and signed by each party: electronically, or by hand on the printed slip.
manifests.signMessage: By signing, you certify that the information on the slip is accurate. Confirm with your password.
manifests.emptyHint: Slips are issued when a pickup is loaded.

methodHints.electronic: I sign now with my password.
methodHints.paper: The printed slip was signed by hand.

manifests.externalHint: This party has no account. Print the slip, have it signed by hand, then type here who signed and when.
manifests.recordMessage: You certify that the slip was signed by hand by this person. Confirm with your password.
manifests.copyHint: Every party has signed, at least one by hand. Attach the scan of the slip carrying the signatures: it closes the slip and becomes the archived document.
manifests.copyFile: Choose the file (PDF, JPG or PNG)

declarations.title: Annual declarations
declarations.subtitle: ANGed declaration calculated from the year's lots and pickups.
declarations.validateHint: The figures will be frozen and the declaration archived for 10 years.
declarations.emptyHint: Prepare the declaration of a site for a year: it is calculated automatically.

documents.emptyHint: Documents appear here as soon as a certificate is uploaded or a tracking slip is signed.

reports.queued: Report requested. It appears below as soon as it is ready.
reports.emptyHint: Choose a report, a period and a format.
reports.productionHint: Number of pieces produced per site and per month: needed for the "waste per piece produced" indicator.

users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: A user can have different roles on different sites.
users.inviteHint: The invitation link is valid for 7 days.
users.removeHint: Their personal account is kept; they lose all access to this company.
users.systemHint: Standard roles are maintained by Diva Software. Create a company role for a specific need.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every creation, change and deletion, with its author.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.subtitle: Your plan, your invoices and your payments.
subscription.requested: Request in progress: {{plan}} for {{sites}} site(s). Diva Software will contact you to activate it.
subscription.change: Change plan or number of sites
subscription.cancelHint: The subscription stays active until the end of the paid period, then the account becomes read-only.
subscription.cancelScheduled: Cancellation scheduled for the end of the current period.
subscription.declared: Transfer declared. It will be validated by Diva Software.
subscription.lapsed: Your subscription has ended: the account is read-only.

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Contact details, logo for reports and weight variance limit.
company.identityHint: The legal name, tax ID and country can only be changed by Diva Software.
company.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, 2 MB maximum. It appears on reports and exports.
company.varianceHint: Beyond this difference between the weight at departure and the weight received, the pickup is flagged (5 % by default).

account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions have been closed.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)

report.title: Costs and gains
report.subtitle: What the orders of the period cost and are worth, with what is missing to trust it.
report.materialIntro: Planned against consumed, for the orders of the period that declared a consumption.
report.supplierIntro: A consumption goes to the supplier of the received lot it comes from. Without a lot, the supplier is unknown.
report.method: Method: actual material cost = quantity consumed × cost of the received lot (price paid, delivery cost spread). Lot not specified = weighted average price of the material, counted as "estimated". A gain is added up only for the orders where it can be calculated. An order belongs to the period by its end date, else its start date, else its creation date. Amounts exclude tax.

stock.title: How to read the stock
stock.text:
The stock is calculated at each display from the lots present on site: nothing is typed here.
Capacity: the room available in a zone, as a number of packages per packaging (one lot may hold several packages) and/or a weight. Room (packages) and load (weight) are two separate limits: each has its own line, figures and result, never a shared percentage. It is set on the page of the site.
Limit: a maximum weight you set for a site, a zone or a waste type. You are warned before it is reached, then when it is exceeded.
"No limit" or "Capacity not defined" means nothing watches this line: click "Define" to add one.

lots.title: Waste lots
lots.text:
A lot is a weighed quantity of a single waste type, with its QR label. It is created here or from the workshop application.
Its status follows its journey: created, stored, awaiting pickup, collected, treated, closed.
Click a lot to see its full history, its origin in production and the pickup that took it.
Nothing is ever deleted: a corrected lot keeps the trace of the correction.

pickups.title: Pickups
pickups.text:
A pickup groups lots of one site handed to a receiver, with or without a separate transporter.
Stages: draft, requested, confirmed (date set), collected (lots loaded), received (weighed on arrival), closed.
If the receiver has an account, it answers itself. Otherwise you record its stages on the pickup page.
Every waste collected leaves with its tracking slip, issued automatically at loading.

sites.title: Sites and zones
sites.text:
A site is a factory or a warehouse. Each site is divided into zones: workshops, storage areas.
Click a site to manage its zones, their capacity and what they are meant to hold.
A site or a zone is not deleted: it is deactivated, and history keeps pointing to it.

zones.title: The zones of this site
zones.text:
Capacity: the room of a zone is measured one way — in packages per packaging ("40 bales or 100 bags", mixed packagings share the same room) or in volume (m³). The maximum load (kg) is a separate limit. The site also has its maximum weight, where every lot counts once. Each limit has its own line and result; none refuses a lot.
Reserved for: the waste types and colours planned in the zone. A lot that does not match is reported, never refused.
The type of the zone (cutting, sewing…) is optional; it tells which production stage a waste comes from.
"No limit" means the filling of the zone is not watched.

wasteTypes.title: Waste types and colours
wasteTypes.text:
Your waste types come from the catalogue of the platform (Catalogue tab) or are created by you.
The code, family, regulatory code and hazardous flag no longer change after creation: documents rely on them.
Tick "under authorisation" for a waste that can only leave with a customs authorisation.
Default colours are shared; the ones you add are visible to your company only.

providers.title: Providers and partners
providers.text:
Partners without an account: transporters and receivers you record yourself. You enter their stages and they sign by hand.
Providers on the platform: they have an account, answer your requests and sign themselves. Add them to your partners to be able to choose them.
A provider whose accreditation has expired cannot be chosen for a pickup.

register.title: The waste register
register.text:
The register lists each lot produced over the period with its exit: pickup, receiver, weight received, channel.
It is generated from the lots: no line is typed by hand.
Export it as PDF or Excel for an inspection.

manifests.title: Tracking slips
manifests.text:
Every waste collected has its slip, hazardous or not, pre-filled from the pickup.
It is signed in order: producer, transporter, receiver. Each signs with their password, or by hand on the printed slip.
A party without an account signs by hand: print the PDF, have it signed, then "Record the signature".
As soon as one signature is handwritten, attach the scan of the signed copy to close the slip.

declarations.title: Annual declarations
declarations.text:
The declaration of a site for a year is calculated from its lots and pickups.
A draft can be recalculated until it is validated. Once validated, the declaration is frozen and archived.

authorizations.title: Exit authorisations
authorizations.text:
Only waste types marked "under authorisation" are concerned (a checkbox on the waste type).
An authorisation gives a period and a quantity: a weight, a number of lots, or packages per packaging.
Each pickup request reserves its share. Without a valid authorisation or with too little left, the request is blocked.
You are warned when the authorisation is almost used up and before it ends.

productionPartners.title: Clients and suppliers
productionPartners.text:
Clients are those you produce for; suppliers deliver your raw materials.
They only serve to tell where each waste comes from. They are not your waste providers.
Enter them here or import them from a file (Production › Import).

productionCatalog.title: Raw materials and articles
productionCatalog.text:
A raw material carries its composition and colour: the waste that comes from it takes them automatically.
Fill in the width and weight of a fabric to get the waste rate of your manufacturing orders.
An article says what one piece should consume of each material: the basis of the planned / actual comparison.

productionOrders.title: Orders
productionOrders.text:
An order lists the articles a client asks for, with quantities.
Manufacturing orders are attached to an order: that link tells for which client a waste was produced.

manufacturingOrders.title: Manufacturing orders
manufacturingOrders.text:
A manufacturing order makes an article. Give its stages and the site of each: it can be cut on one site and sewn on another.
Enter what the order really consumed: the form compares with the plan and flags any excess.
Waste lots are attached to an order when they are created (form or workshop application).
The produced quantity of a finished order feeds the "waste per piece produced" of the dashboard.

productionStats.title: How to read these statistics
productionStats.text:
Measured: the lot names its manufacturing order. This is an exact figure.
Estimated (≈): the lot only says its stage; its weight is shared between the orders at that stage that day, by pieces done.
Not attributed: the lot says nothing. The lower this figure, the more reliable your statistics.
Waste rate: share of the consumed material that became waste. It needs the consumption in kg, or in metres with width and weight.

reports.title: Reports and exports
reports.text:
Choose a report, a period and a format: it is prepared in the background and appears in the list when ready.
A report is visible only to the person who requested it and stays available for 30 days.

productionLots.title: Three kinds of lot, not to be confused
productionLots.text:
Received lot: a delivery of raw material by a supplier. It tells where the material comes from and what it cost.
Produced lot: finished goods made by an order for its client. It has no supplier.
Waste lot: waste from production, managed in Operations → Waste lots.
None of these is a stock: no balance, no location and no movement is kept here.

productionFinance.title: How to read costs and gains
productionFinance.text:
Actual material cost: quantity consumed × cost of the received lot it comes from. A lot used by several orders is shared by what each one consumed.
Estimated material cost: when the lot is not specified, the quantity is valued at the average price of the material — and counted apart.
Value of production: pieces made × price agreed on the order. It is not what was invoiced.
Recorded gain: value of production − recorded costs (materials + other expenses). It is computed only when everything is known; otherwise what is missing is listed.
This is not an accounting result: no overheads, no labour unless entered as an expense. Amounts exclude tax.

tolerance.title: Gaps at reception
tolerance.summary: {{flagged}} to review out of {{total}} lot(s) compared

reasons.blocking: The gap exceeds the {{pct}} % limit: it must be accepted by an authorised person.

rules.title: Tolerances
rules.intro: The gap accepted between the quantity that left and the quantity received, as a percentage of the first. A rule is for a waste type, a channel, both, or every waste; the most precise one applies. The gap is judged in the unit of the waste: pieces with pieces, kilos with kilos.
rules.dialogHint: Above the warning limit the gap must be explained. Above the blocking limit it must be accepted by an authorised person before the pickup is closed.
rules.warningHint: Empty: no warning before the blocking limit.
rules.blockingHint: Empty: the gap never blocks, it only has to be explained.
rules.referenceHint: The text that sets this limit (decree, order, contract). Required for a regulatory requirement.

problem.order: The blocking limit cannot be below the warning limit.

rules.history: A changed rule applies to the next receptions. Receptions already recorded keep the rule applied to them, and every change is in the audit trail.
rules.deleteHint: The next receptions will fall back on the more general rule. Decisions already taken do not change.

byType.title: Gaps at reception by waste type

requirements.notMet: At least {{min}} asked — the collection is {{have}}: {{short}} short.
